cards.headline: Christensen suffers mild left soleus discomfort and is a doubt for Villarreal
cards.summary:
Andreas Christensen missed Friday’s session after feeling discomfort in the soleus of his left leg during Thursday’s work. The club confirmed in an official medical note that the 30-year-old is a doubt for Sunday’s match against Villarreal at 14:00.

SPORT and Mundo Deportivo both reported he is likely to be left out. Recovery time will depend on how the issue evolves. He had only just returned against Atlético on 8 November after a seven-game absence with a quadriceps problem. Eric García and Gerard Martín remain the main options at centre-back.

cards.headline: Koundé completes second day with the group and points to Villarreal
cards.summary:
Jules Koundé trained with the full group for a second consecutive day on Friday at the Ciutat Esportiva. He has been out since the ankle sprain picked up against Betis on 17 October and is now close to medical clearance.

Mundo Deportivo reported he is gaining ground for a place in the squad for Sunday’s 14:00 kick-off against Villarreal. Alex Pintanel of RAC1 confirmed he worked with Cubarsí and Olmo. Flick will decide after Saturday’s session whether the 27-year-old is available for the Spotify Camp Nou return.

cards.headline: Cubarsí and Olmo continue group work ahead of Sunday
cards.summary:
Pau Cubarsí trained with the group again on Friday after the iliopsoas overload that forced him off against England. Dani Olmo, recovering from the left adductor tear sustained at PSG on 20 October, also completed the session.

Both are expected to be available for Villarreal, though Cubarsí’s minutes may be managed. Cadena SER and Europa Press noted the pair joined the opening work earlier in the week. Only Rodri (hamstring), Espart (syndesmosis) and Bardghji (knee) remain fully unavailable among the senior group.

cards.headline: Espart signs until 2030 and speaks after the deal
cards.summary:
Xavi Espart put pen to paper with Joan Laporta on Friday, extending his contract until 30 June 2030. The 19-year-old La Masia product is currently recovering from the syndesmosis injury picked up in the Clásico.

In his first comments he said Flick’s comparison with Philipp Lahm surprised him but gave him confidence. He added he will play wherever the coach needs him and is focused on returning. The previous deal ran until 2028. He is expected back around mid-December.

cards.headline: Barça host Villarreal on Sunday at 14:00 looking to protect the lead
cards.summary:
Barça face Villarreal at Spotify Camp Nou on Sunday at 14:00 in La Liga. The side arrive as leaders and will look to extend their advantage over Real Madrid.

Flick has almost the full group available after the international break, with late checks on Koundé, Cubarsí and Olmo. The Yellow Submarine have been one of the more physical sides this season. From 22 November the schedule includes nine matches in a month, seven of them at home.

cards.headline: Spain drawn against France in Nations League quarter-finals
cards.summary:
Spain were drawn to face France in the quarter-finals of the Nations League. The draw pairs several Barça players on both sides, including Yamal, Cubarsí, Pedri and Fermín for Spain.

Barça Blaugranes and Bleacher Report carried the news on Friday. The ties will be played in March. Cubarsí’s availability for the club remains the more immediate concern after his recent overload.

cards.headline: De Jong and the internationals settle back into full training
cards.summary:
Frenkie de Jong completed the opening part of Friday’s session after the obturator stretch that forced him to leave the Germany camp early. Raphinha and the remaining internationals are fully integrated.

The club confirmed the group trained at the Ciutat Esportiva with the focus on Villarreal. Flick will manage the loads carefully across the next three matches, which also include Sabah in Baku on Wednesday. Eric García remains available after his return against Atlético.

cards.headline: Rodri still targeting Atlético on 2 December
cards.summary:
Rodri remains out with the minor right-hamstring issue that kept him out of the Atlético match on 8 November. Earlier updates from the club and MARCA pointed to the home game against Atlético on 2 December as a possible return date.

He has not featured since the injury. Pedri and Bernal continue to share the midfield load in his absence. Flick has said he will not rush anyone who is not fully ready for the busy run of fixtures.
